_about: Gadzhi Motion, yellow theme. Gadzhi Motion (studied from @manoocreates and @brettfully Iman-Gadzhi-style edits, 12 Oct 2026, ~/reels/focus-refs/STUDY.md style A): the speaker cut out onto a dark purple studio, a small white sans caption of 1-3 words mid-frame, and every 2-4 s a full-screen motion graphic replaces him (gm-object 3D object + mixed type on grey paper, gm-kinetic type page, gm-flow glass icon tiles joined by drawn curves, gm-counter glass card with a counting number, gm-nodes numbered chips into an object on red). Real footage with a clean cinematic grade; graphics only on 3-4 key beats. Colour themes: gadzhi-motion (purple), gadzhi-blue, gadzhi-yellow, gadzhi-red, gadzhi-green.

director.rules: Only 3-4 full-screen graphics per ~25 s, on the strongest beats (hook, a number, a list, the payoff); the rest is the speaker's real footage with small captions. Never two graphics back to back. All type on graphics is spoken. No real people, companies or logos.
director.style: Chrome Motion: the speaker cut out onto a dark studio, with a clean cinematic grade. Cut about every 2.2 s; put the strongest beats (the hook, a number, a list, the payoff) wholly inside a take with a second of plain footage either side, because that is where a full-screen graphic lands.
director.restraint: Only 3-4 full-screen graphics per ~25 s and never two back to back; the rest is the speaker's real footage with small captions. All type on a graphic is spoken. No real people, companies or logos.
